_basis: Document fixture built only from facts recorded in company memory/specs as of 2026-11-14: ManagerBench promotion is judged by a single accuracy number against a simple prior on the same case set (MG-04: v2.0 19/37 vs prior 22/37; v2.1 0.5286 vs 0.5571; v2.2 pairwise 0.5000 vs prior 0.5748); the eval case form is situation -> stimulus -> measured human reaction, with ground truth from real reactions; the 2026-11-14 correction records that the suite gave no per-person history, so a population-average prior structurally wins, and that intervention cases (where the prior has no answer) and confidence intervals were missing. No capability/regression split, no multi-trial structure, no reference-solution record, no transcript-reading cadence, and no saturation monitoring are recorded anywhere in those documents, so they are encoded as absent here. Absent-in-documents is what this fixture measures; it is not a direct audit of the live harness code.
